description: Get the latest MeteoSwiss OGD measurements for one station by reading the STAC CSV asset (10-minute/hourly 'now' file when available, otherwise the recent file). Times are Swiss local time. Use list_ogd_stations for codes such as BER, SMA, LUG.

collection.description: OGD collection alias (default smn). Aliases: smn, smn-precip, smn-tower, nime, nbcn, nbcn-precip, obs, phenology, tot. A full STAC id such as ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn is also accepted.

granularity.description: Resolution: t (10-minute), h (hourly, default), d (daily), m (monthly), y (yearly).

limit.description: Number of most recent rows (default 24, max 168).

parameters.description: Comma-separated parameter codes (e.g. tre200h0,rre150h0). Omit for the common temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind, pressure, sunshine, and radiation columns. Use 'all' for the first data columns.

station.description: Station abbreviation (e.g. BER, SMA, LUG, BAS).

name: get_ogd_recent
